caveats: Current-constituent backtest: both universes were selected in Nov 2026 with hindsight, so the 2024-2026 series carries survivorship and look-ahead bias by construction. Read it as 'how today's names travelled', not as an achievable track record.
Price return only (ordinary dividends unadjusted), equal weight, quarterly rebalance on the last trading day of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec — production methodology v3.0 mechanics.

Late listings (IPO / spin-off / relisting after 2024-01-02) enter at the first quarterly rebalance on/after their sourced regular-way listing date (data/research/listing_dates.csv); when-issued and pre-listing prints never count.
Research source: Yahoo Finance EOD via yfinance (split-adjusted close). Not a licensed index-data feed; internal research view only, never a published index value (methodology §8 publication gate).
Universe files are the versions checked into this repo. The Mixed universe file predates the 2026-11-09 20/60/20 rebalance; re-run after it lands.
Benchmarks are ETF price proxies rebased to 1000 on the same base date; licensed index values are never fetched.
